name: Cobalt carbonate FG
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CoCO3. This product is of feed grade quality. Other name: cobalt(II) carbonate.

name: Processed animal proteins, poultry, protein 45-60%
description: Slaugherhouse byproduct obtained from healthy poultry slaughtered for human consumption. The product is ground, sterilized by cooking, and dried. The product must be substantially free of feathers. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Alfalfa, dehydrated, protein 16-18% dry matter
description: Dehydrated aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.), containing between 16% and 18% protein (in dry matter).

name: Zinc metal
description: Zinc (Zn) in metallic form.

name: Maize flour, crude fibre < 2%
description: Maize flour (Zea maysL.), normally used for human consumption or for petfood.

name: Magnesium lactate
description: Organic chemical compound that is the magnesium salt of lactic acid. This mineral supplement is used as an acidity regulator and known as E329.

name: Beet pulp, dried
description: Dried byproduct of sugar manufacture, obtained after extracting the juice from sugar beet roots (Beta vulgarisL.). Other name: sugar beet pulp.

name: Linseed, whole, extruded
description: Extruded, whole linseed (Linum usitatissimumL.). Other names: full-fat linseed, full-fat flaxseed

name: Magnesium citrate
description: Organic chemical compound that is a magnesium preparation in salt form with citric acid in a 1:1 ratio. As a food additive, magnesium citrate is used to regulate acidity and is known as E345.

name: Cereal offal, crude fibre 5-14%
description: Byproduct of the processing of cereal grains of undetermined species. This product contains 5-14% (as fed) of crude fibre.

name: Sodium bicarbonate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula NaHCO3. Sodium bicarbonate is a major food additive, and is used in livestock feeding as a buffering agent.

name: Rapeseed meal, oil 5-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of rapeseeds (Brassica napusL.,Brassica rapaL. andBrassica junceaL., and their crosses) from varieties having a low content in erucic acid and glucosinolates ("00" in Europe, canola in North America). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only. Other names: rapeseed cake, "00" rapeseed meal, canola cake, canola meal (for North American rapeseed cultivars).

name: Wheat, durum
description: Grains of durum wheat (Triticum durumL., also known asTriticum turgidumL. subsp.durum(Desf.) Husn.). Durum wheat is normally used for the production of pasta and semolina.

name: Ammonium molybdate tetrahydrate
description: Inorganic chemical compound, normally encountered as the tetrahydrate, with the chemical formula (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O. It is a colorless solid. Other names: ammonium paramolybdate, ammonium molybdate.

name: Calcium iodide
description: Inorganic chemical compound and the ionic compound of calcium and iodine with the formula CaI2.

name: Wheat bran, durum
description: Byproduct of wheat flour or semolina production obtained by the milling of durum wheat grains (Triticum durumL., also known asTriticum turgidumL. subsp.durum(Desf.) Husn.). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain from which the greater part of the endosperm has been removed.

name: Soybean oil
description: Oil extracted from soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.).

name: Soybean, whole, toasted
description: Toasted (dry heated) soybean seed (Glycine max(L.) Merr.). Other name: toasted full-fat soybean.

name: Fish meal, protein 65%
description: Fish product or fishery byproduct obtained by processing whole or parts of fish. This type of fish meal contains 63-68% protein (as fed). Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Soybean meal, oil 5-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.
